hypothesis: LLM-primary semantic proposals plus independently requested coverage audit and finite deterministic certification can preserve cross-surface predicate/argument/discourse semantics without parallel NLP semantic generation.
primary_gate: Source-semantic correctness, independent binding/modality/condition/coverage checks, then complete Root 7+1 closure
minimum_expected_delta: Cross-category improvements against reproduced historical 16/50,9/100,200/200; historical scores are not new results
falsification: Unsupported certified fact, clear omission, collapsed ambiguity, locked first-run semantic error, or provider cannot execute automatically
stop_rule: At most 4 parser,3 auditor,3 evidence-policy major versions; two successive versions without net improvement stop direction; no tuning after locked first run
provider_inputs: Source + literal/structure contract only. No expected, old semantic outputs, root-cause notes or benchmark case IDs.
